column1: # input and the findings Hidden (Go) and scripts/sourcehygiene-scan.py (Python) must both give (ADR-0045).
# Row: <name><TAB><input><TAB><expected>. name: unique, not empty, does not start with #.
# input: printable ASCII as it is; every other character is {U+XXXX} (4-6 upper-case hex digits) and an invalid UTF-8 byte is {xHH} (80-FF).
#   A { or } is written {U+007B} / {U+007D}. Any other brace, a printable ASCII character written as {U+XXXX}, a surrogate and an empty input are reader errors.
# expected: none, or <line>:<col> U+XXXX joined by commas (col counts runes; an invalid byte counts as one).
# This file is ASCII only. The first rows moved here from TestInvisible_Table (invisible_test.go) with their names; the edge rows at the end are required by
# exported_table_test.go: one row for the first and the last rune of every row of hidden-ranges.tsv, and the rune on each side that is not hidden.
